title: Piramal Finance expects 50% profit growth in FY27 as AI boosts productivity and lending
summary: The company's in-house artificial intelligence programme is beginning to deliver measurable gains in employee productivity, credit risk management and digital lending. New business lines, including digital lending and cross-selling, now account for quarterly disbursements of about Rs 4,000 crore.________________

direction_reasons: TECHNOLOGY cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: confirmation from an official or company source
KSOLVES.why_it_matters: This is industry-level news rather than company news via its technology exposure to artificial intelligence. The parts of the business most likely touched are product, competition. Classified as technology.
